name: Civil Aviation Authority of Bangladesh — airports in Mymensingh Division
notes: No licence stated. CAAB names no airport or airfield in Mymensingh Division: the caab.gov.bd airport menu has no page for one, and the new.caab.gov.bd 'All airports' overview (three international airports; 'TWELVE DOMESTIC AIRPORTS': five operational, three needing prior approval, three with no service, one under construction) names none in Mymensingh, Jamalpur, Sherpur or Netrokona. places.csv is therefore empty (header only); raw/airportsf.txt keeps the overview text as evidence. No airfield was added from other sources.
